decision: Best fixed-RC case improves setup0.667695ns but still-2.260117ns; do not spend DRT on these changes alone. All20 worst baseline paths share the IDLE latch. Prioritize sparse equivalent storage conversion; slew repair remains separate.

slew_investigation.limits: Placement is pre-DRT source geometry; new source profile will change IDs/placement. Capacitance is mostly wire/loading rather than a single antenna cell; do not claim post-DRT locations verified.
slew_investigation.next: If the new source still shows this slew failure, identify its actual new driver/net and test a buffer close to the weak source instead of blindly increasing far-end input capacitance.
